item.name: 01 建立 LINE 授權流程

exec: pm.test('authorize HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('授權回應格式正確', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.authorizationUrl).to.include('/api/auth/line/mock/authorize'); pm.expect(body.data.expiresAt).to.be.a('string'); });
const state = decodeURIComponent(body.data.authorizationUrl.match(/[?&]state=([^&]+)/)[1]);
pm.collectionVariables.set('state', state);
pm.test('state 已建立且不回傳敏感 verifier', () => { pm.expect(state.length).to.be.above(30); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(body)).not.to.include('codeVerifier'); });

item.name: 02 首次 LINE callback 註冊登入

exec: pm.test('callback HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('首次 LINE 登入 JWT response 正確', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.tokenType).to.eql('Bearer'); pm.expect(body.data.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.data.roles).to.include('EMPLOYEE'); pm.expect(body.data.fullName).to.eql('LINE 測試使用者'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('lineUsername', body.data.username);

pm.test('SUCCESS 稽核已完成', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.status).to.eql('SUCCESS'); pm.expect(data.resultCode).to.eql('SUCCESS'); pm.expect(data.completed).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('已使用 state 回 401', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('state 無效或已使用'); });
pm.test('再次 authorize HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const url = pm.response.json().data.authorizationUrl; pm.collectionVariables.set('state', decodeURIComponent(url.match(/[?&]state=([^&]+)/)[1]));
pm.test('再次登入仍為相同本地帳號', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.username).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('lineUsername')); });

item.name: 07 建立 provider 失敗流程

exec: const url = pm.response.json().data.authorizationUrl; pm.collectionVariables.set('failureState', decodeURIComponent(url.match(/[?&]state=([^&]+)/)[1]));
pm.test('失敗流程 state 已建立', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('provider 失敗回 502 與安全訊息', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(502); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.message).to.include('LINE 驗證服務'); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(body)).not.to.include('provider-error'); });

pm.test('FAILED 稽核已完成', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.status).to.eql('FAILED'); pm.expect(data.resultCode).to.eql('PROVIDER_ERROR'); pm.expect(data.completed).to.eql(true); });
const url = pm.response.json().data.authorizationUrl; pm.collectionVariables.set('deniedState', decodeURIComponent(url.match(/[?&]state=([^&]+)/)[1]));
pm.test('取消流程 state 已建立', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('取消授權回 400', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('授權已取消'); });

pm.test('DENIED 稽核已完成', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.status).to.eql('DENIED'); pm.expect(data.resultCode).to.eql('ACCESS_DENIED'); pm.expect(data.completed).to.eql(true); });
